'''Requiem Nine''' was the position that Corran Horn took during an undercover mission, alias [[Requiem Squadron]], in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. He posed as [[Corran Horn/Legends|Captain Pyr "Klick" Hand]].
